title: "Elastic net"
format: html
execute: 
  eval: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
set.seed(12112026)
library("tidymodels")
library("tidyverse")
```

```{r}
# | label: import-data
data <- read_csv("data-processed/train_by_uid.csv")
```

inspired by [Tidymodels case-study](https://www.tidymodels.org/start/case-study/).

```{r}
#| label: split
splits <- initial_validation_split(
    data, prop = c(0.60, 0.15))

data_train <- training(splits)
data_val   <- validation(splits)
data_test  <- testing(splits)
data_other <- bind_rows(data_train, data_val)

val_set <- validation_set(splits)
```
```{r}
#| label: lm-recipe
lm_rec <- 
    recipe(is_fraud ~ ., data = data_other) |> 
    update_role(uid, new_role = "id variable") |>
    step_zv(all_predictors()) |> 
    step_impute_mean(all_predictors())
```

```{r}
#| label: untuned-model
lm_mod <- 
    linear_reg(penalty = tune(), mixture = tune()) |> 
    set_engine("glmnet")
```

```{r}
#| label: workflow
lm_workflow <- 
  workflow() |> 
  add_model(lm_mod) |> 
  add_recipe(lm_rec)
```

```{r}
#| label: tuning-grid
params_list <- list(
  penalty = 10^seq(-4, -1, length.out = 30),
  mixture = 10^seq(-4, -1, length.out = 30)
)
lm_reg_grid <- 
  params_list |> 
  expand.grid() |> 
  as_tibble()
```

```{r}
#| label: params-tuning
lm_res <- 
  lm_workflow |> 
  tune_grid(
    val_set,
    grid = lm_reg_grid,
    control = control_grid(save_pred = TRUE),
    metrics = metric_set(rmse))
```

```{r}
#| label: top-models
top_models <-
  lm_res |> 
  show_best(metric = "rmse", n = 15) |> 
  arrange(penalty) 
top_models

best_model <- select_best(lm_res, metric = "rmse")
```

```{r}
#| label: last-model
# Last model
last_lm_mod <- 
  linear_reg(
    penalty = best_model$penalty,
    mixture = best_model$mixture) |> 
  set_engine("glmnet")

# the last workflow
last_workflow <- 
  lm_workflow |> 
  update_model(last_lm_mod)

last_res <- 
  last_workflow |> 
  last_fit(splits)

last_res |> collect_metrics() |> knitr::kable(caption = "Metrics of elastic net")
```
